proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6811 *dhipp explicitly lists Maithili dhīpal warm and dhipāeb to warm. Magahi dhīpal hot matches that documented extended adjective; the expressive origin and possible influence of dīp are retained. Exact source form dʰīpal is preserved.
